title: The Warded Lock Companion
summary: A companion for the seal-aligned past the courses that sets a ward-lock on a foe's core channel and bursts the stored ward outward.

title: A Treatise on the Sealed Limb
summary: A treatise on closing off a single limb of the foe from the rest of his qi and breaking the joint with the seal.

title: The Canon of the Closed Field
summary: A canon on closing the foe's whole qi field so he cannot draw or push qi and on laying a closed field upon the ground.

title: The Azure Sigil Treatise
summary: A treatise of the Azure Sky halls on branding a sigil of sealed qi onto the foe that holds one technique shut.

title: Manual of the Skyward Interdict
summary: A manual of the interdict that forbids a named technique to the foe and spreads wide to damp every technique near.

title: The Sapphire Lock Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of the tumblers of a master lock of qi and of the key that locks the last of a failing life in.

title: The Gale Oath Latch Discipline
summary: A discipline of the Gale oath-schools in which a seal holds as long as the oath that set it is kept.

title: Treatise of the Wind-Sworn Seal
summary: A treatise on the seal of calm that stills the air about the foe and drops every technique into a dead lull.

title: The Sworn Silence Canon
summary: A canon of the sworn silence that seals the voice and the technique of the foe and quiets all near him.
